node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double factor reduction
node.statement: In the cubic 2+2+2 profile, the three double fibers factor L into quadratics F_i=W^2+u_iW+u_i^2-Uu_i+V belonging to one two-parameter family. Their external roots are y_i=u_i-U, and the three constants w+(u_i^2-Uu_i+V)(u_i-U) obey the scale-free ratio of the chosen three eighth-root colors.
node.notes: Exact low-degree necessary factor model for 2+2+2 only. It replaces the generic degree-nine remainder but supplies no emptiness verdict.
